title: Financial Exchange Rate Project
subtitle: Debt-based financial exchange rate indices for euro-area countries

frequency_notes.annual: Annual series are Q4 snapshots of the quarterly FER indices.
frequency_notes.quarterly: Quarterly is the baseline FER series used in the main construction.
frequency_notes.monthly: Monthly FER holds portfolio and balance-sheet weights fixed within the relevant quarter or year and lets variation come from monthly BIS exchange-rate changes.
